name: MailMergeField
description: Represents a single mail merge field in a document. The MailMergeDataField object is a member of the MailMergeDataFields collection. The MailMergeDataFields collection includes all the mail merge related fields in a document.
remarks: Use Fields (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single MailMergeField object. The following example displays the field code of the first mail merge field in the active document. Use the Add method to add a merge field to the MailMergeFields collection. The following example replaces the selection with a MiddleInitial merge field. The MailMergeFields collection has additional methods, such as AddAsk and AddFillIn, for adding fields related to a mail merge operation.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified MailMergeField object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the field type. Read-only WdFieldType.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: True if the specified field is locked. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Code
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a field's code. Read/write.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns the next mail merge field in the collection of mail merge fields. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns the previous mail merge field in the collection of mail merge fields. Read-only.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the specified mail merge field.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified mail merge field to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Removes the specified mail merge field from the document and moves it to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified mail merge field.
